title: Loop Fixer
body:
Goal: this program should draw a blue square and an orange star. It has 2 loop bugs. Find and fix them.

  1. Open starter.py and press Run (F5). Watch carefully.
  2. Square bug: count the sides. How many times does the loop repeat?
  3. Star bug: the star is a straight line! Which line is NOT inside the loop? (Look at the spaces at the start of each line.)
  4. Fix one bug, press Run, then fix the other.

Done looks like: a closed blue square and a closed orange 5-pointed star.

Challenge: draw a 7-pointed star: 7 sides, turn 360 x 3 / 7, about 154.

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Run the program and watch both shapes. The blue square and the orange star each have one bug. Look at the two for loops in starter.py one at a time.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: For the square, count its sides, then check the number inside range(...). For the star, look at the spaces at the start of each line. A line only belongs to the loop if it is pushed in under the for line.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Square: say how many sides a square has, then read the number in range(____). Do they match? Star: look at the spaces at the start of the two lines under the star's for. Do both lines line up? Fix one bug, press Run, then fix the other.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Loop Fixer
# This program has 2 bugs. Run it, watch, then fix them one at a time.

import turtle

t = turtle.Turtle()
t.shape("turtle")
t.pensize(3)

# A blue square
t.penup()
t.goto(-200, -50)
t.pendown()
t.color("#0072B2")
for i in range(3):
    t.forward(100)
    t.left(90)

# An orange star with 5 points
t.penup()
t.goto(50, 0)
t.pendown()
t.color("#E69F00")
for i in range(5):
    t.forward(150)
t.right(144)

turtle.done()
